title: S4-ANIM-02 — Holds and playback remain editable.
goal: A two-frame animation held 100 and 200 ms plays and pauses, plays at 2x preview speed without changing its stored holds, and in Once mode stops by itself on the last frame; artwork and holds stay exact.

steps.say: Click the timeline's Play button with the mouse: the button at the bottom left showing a ▶ triangle and the word 'Play' (its tooltip reads 'Play / Pause Animation (Enter)'). Do not use the Space key.

steps.why: Preview speed does not rewrite the stored holds.

steps.say: Click the timeline's Play button with the mouse: the button at the bottom left showing a ▶ triangle and the word 'Play' (its tooltip reads 'Play / Pause Animation (Enter)'). Do not use the Space key.

steps.why: In Once mode playback stops by itself on the last frame.

cliOnly: measured on-screen frame timing at 1x and 2x (tests/production/playbackStall.spec.ts, tests/production/motionEditing.spec.ts)
